messages:
anya: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a double-buffer + manifest-driven resume model for air-gapped installs. Wants a compact rollback plan and operator-friendly markers.

mira: Agree on double-buffer. Manifest should include transport_hint, chunk_index, and revert_plan reference. Keep manifest under 4KB if possible. :thinking_face: 

shankar: Signature streaming is mandatory. We can stream-verify chunks using an incremental Merkle-like chain; no need to retain full blobs. Pseudo: verify header->chunk sigs on write.

leo: Activation must be 1) record intent, 2) switch pointer atomically, 3) run health checks, 4) clear intent. Use symlink swap on ext4; fallback for NFS: write activation token to cluster metadata store. Document powercut recovery steps.

Tj: Minimal activation snippet:

```
# stage in /opt/redwood/versions/<id>
echo "apply_id=<id>" > /var/lib/redwood/activation.marker
ln -sfn /opt/redwood/versions/<id> /opt/redwood/current
# run health checks; on success: rm /var/lib/redwood/activation.marker
```

devops: Transport modes: usb / rsync-host / jump-host pull. UI shows transport_hint and printable operator steps.

mira: Rollback: precompute revert_plan JSON at stage. CLI: `redwood rollback --apply-id <id> --fast` executes recorded steps. Provide dry-run to preview.

shankar: Protect progress logs with HMAC using the same verification key; prevents tamper on shared operator boxes.

leo: Observability: emit events: apply_id, bytes_staged, verify_time, activate_time, health_ok. Page if activation > 10 minutes.

sre-oncall: Also expose /metrics for rollout progress; add alert runbook link.

ops-bot: lint: offline-pkg-schema OK (sha256: c7e9...). CI: 42/42.

anya: Action items: tj -> script README EOW; mira -> manifest addendum 3d; shankar -> verify pseudo + KMS 3d; leo -> failure playbook EOW. I'll fold into RFC follow-up unless objections.
